channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Writers, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Writers, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Writers prize - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• The Richell Prize for Emerging Writers 2026
    https://emergingwritersfestival.org.au/richell-prize-2026/
    Emerging Writers' Festival and Hachette Australia · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · AUD $10,000 prize money (donated by Hachette Australia); 12-month mentorship with a Hachette Australia publisher; first option to consider finished work for publication. Long- and short-listed writers also eligible to apply for a Casa Morphosi Residency in Abruzzo, Italy. No application fee.
